## EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.optionTerminatorLetters property

No-operand letters that end option scanning after the current cluster, under either sign. Remaining letters in that cluster still take effect: zsh's `-b -c script` runs the file `-c`<!-- -->, but `-bc cmd` selects a string. These letters must not include `c` or an operand-taking letter.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly optionTerminatorLetters?: readonly string[];
```
